description: Cost: free. Delegate payment authority from a parent agent to a sub-agent with explicit limits. The sub-agent can only spend up to the delegated ceiling. Delegation can be revoked at any time. Use in multi-agent workflows where an orchestrator authorises a worker agent to make payments on its behalf.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when this delegation expires. Omit for no expiry.

max_per_tx.description: Maximum USD per transaction for the sub-agent

max_total.description: Lifetime spending ceiling for this delegation

policy_id.description: Policy ID to inherit (optional — inherits parent policy if omitted)

wallet_nonce.description: Single-use nonce used in the signed message.

wallet_signature.description:
EIP-191 signature from agent_id (must be a wallet address) over "METHOD
PATH
SHA256(BODY)
TIMESTAMP_MS
NONCE", where BODY is JSON.stringify of these arguments without the wallet_* fields. Required unless the operator uses an admin key.

wallet_timestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch used in the signed message (±5 min).

name: policy.delegate
